summary: Vishay Intertechnology Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to offer 15 million shares of common stock at $50.00 per share, with an underwriter option for an additional 2.25 million shares. Net proceeds to the company are approximately $723.75 million. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Shares trade on NYSE under VSH, with a last reported price of $56.35. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation element. This is a standard equity issuance for general corporate purposes.
